programs.title: Silver Star
programs.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programs.title: The Idea of You
programs.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programs.title: Venom
programs.desc: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is an ambitious investigative journalist who, thanks to his determination, always achieves his goal.However, when one of his missions - exposing the unethical activities of the Life Foundation - turns into an obsession, Eddie loses his job and breaks up with his fiancée Anne (Michelle Williams).Weakened, he accidentally enters into a symbiosis with an alien - the fruit of the experiments of the company owner, the sinister millionaire Calton Drake (Riz Ahmed).The journalist and the alien together create a powerful and bloodthirsty monster.Eddie must find a way out of the situation before a dangerous monster takes him completely over.Meanwhile, Drake follows the reporter's trail and wants to get his property back.The comic Venom was created years ago by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane.

programs.title: The Royal Hotel
programs.desc: Two American friends, Hanna (Julia Garner) and Liv (Jessica Henwick), decide to travel around Australia this summer.Unfortunately, at some point they run out of money.Women need to find temporary work.Their choice falls on a provincial mining settlement, where there is the only local bar called "The Royal Hotel".They quickly manage to adapt to the unusual atmosphere of this place, although this requires developing a specific strategy.Soon they are faced with a situation over which they lose control.

programs.title: Lord Of The Flies
programs.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: Closer
programs.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programs.title: Den sidste viking
programs.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programs.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programs.desc: The situation of the mutant monkeys changes with the appearance of a formation led by the Colonel, which seeks to take control of the apes.Meanwhile, Blue Eyes informs his father that he has found a place for their tribe to live.The decision is made to march.Under the cover of darkness, an attack occurs.Caesar's son and wife are killed.Despite the tragedy, the primate leader believes in the success of a peaceful solution.On his own, he searches for the person responsible for the massacre, but falls into the hands of the enemy.He then finds out that his compatriots were forced to work as slaves.People are attacked by a virus that reverses the process of evolution.The final showdown is inevitably approaching.
